# PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik

PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik is a psychotherapy clinic located in Region Hovedstaden, Denmark, that appears repeatedly in the ADHD-databasens 2024 årsrapport as a data point in the national quality monitoring of adult ADHD treatment. The clinic is discussed in connection with two distinct quality indicators tracked in the report: Indikator 9, which measures the share of adult ADHD patients who received psychotherapy within one year of starting treatment, and Indikator 10, which measures whether a patient's social support needs were assessed within 120 days of treatment start [^src1] [^src3].

On Indikator 9 — a newly implemented measure covering only patients whose treatment began between 1 April 2024 and 31 July 2024 — the national fulfilment rate was an alarmingly low 1% across 786 patients, far below the 90% development target set for the indicator [^src1]. Against that national backdrop, PCK stood out: among departments with at least three patients in the denominator, results ranged from 0% at most departments up to 9% at PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik in Hovedstaden — making PCK the best-performing unit in the country on this measure [^src1]. The clinic's underlying figures for this indicator were 3 patients out of 32 achieving the outcome, yielding the reported 9% (with a confidence interval of 2–25) [^src1].

PCK also appears in the report's discussion of a different measure — apparently Indikator 10 or a related social-support-assessment indicator — where its performance was notably weaker. Here, among departments with more than three patients, results ranged from a low of 21% at PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik in Hovedstaden up to 100% at three other units: PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier in Region Nordjylland, PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt in Region Midtjylland, and PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium in Aabenraa [^src3]. PCK's raw numbers for this measure were 28 out of 135 patients meeting the standard, or 21% (confidence interval 14–29) [^src3]. A separate table entry also records a figure of 50% (68 out of 135, confidence interval 42–59) for the clinic on a related metric [^src2].

Taken together, these mentions position PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik as a facility whose performance varied sharply depending on which quality indicator was being measured — from best-in-country on Indikator 9's psychotherapy-access measure to the lowest performer among larger departments on the social-support-assessment measure. No relationships to other organizations, individuals, or corporate structures are documented for PCK in the corpus; its presence in the record is entirely as a benchmarked clinical department in the ADHD-databasens annual report.
